Hymn 325: See the Mighty Priesthood Gathered
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Ebenezer Beesley

This is hymn number 325 titled "See the Mighty Priesthood Gathered" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Ebenezer Beesley and the lyrics were written by Louis F. Mönch.
